content: sam_index_load/load2 are thin wrappers around hts_idx_load3 which reads .bai or .csi index files. The BAI format is well-documented (binary, bin-based). noodles-bam has a pure Rust BAI reader. Depends on pure Rust BGZF (#65) for virtual offset arithmetic, but the index itself is a separate binary format.
